# Create an aesthetically pleasing quarto output containing at least one table and one figure

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Load libraries
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)


Penguins <- penguins
```


# Create one figure using the penguin data
Be sure to make the figure _aesthetically pleasing_ and **publication ready**! Some things to consider are:

- Clear titles and legends
- Legible fonts
- Nice themes
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-align: "center"
#| label: fig-BillDepth-BillLength-Sex
#| fig-cap: "A scatterplot depicting the relationship between bill length and depth for adelie penguins. Blue points represent male penguins and pink points represent females. The solid colored lines are the best fit ordinary least squares linear regressions, with the 95% confidence intervals for the regression lines shown by the grey shading."
Plot <- Penguins |> # take Penguns dataframe
  filter(species == "Adelie", !is.na(sex)) |> #Keep only adelie penguins and remove any sex which is unknown
  ggplot(aes(bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, color = sex)) + #set color here so both points and lines get it. 
  geom_point(aes(color = sex)) + # Color points by sex. 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + # OLS linear regression. Shading set to 95% CI by defealt. 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(female = "deeppink2", male = "deepskyblue2")) + #manually set colors. This effects both points and lines. 
  labs(x = "Bill length (mm)", y = "Bill depth (mm)", color = "Sex") + # Did not know you could change legend text inside the labs like this! 
  theme_bw()

Plot

ggsave(here("Week_06", "Output", "Homework_Plot_BillDepth_BillLength_Sex.png"),
       plot = Plot,
       width = 9, height = 5,
       create.dir = TRUE) # Error was coming up when deploying to the cloud. I think there is no directory on the cloud, so this will create path if one is missing. 
```

# Create one table using the penguin data
```{r}
#| label: tbl-adelie-bill #prefix with tbl to enable automatic updates
#| tbl-cap: "Mean bill dimensions by sex in Adelie penguins."
#| tbl-cap-location: bottom #move caption below table. For some reason above is default. 

Penguins |>
  filter(species == "Adelie", !is.na(sex)) |> #Keep only adelie penguins and remove any sex which is unknown
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarise(
    Mean_bill_length = round(mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    Mean_bill_depth = round(mean(bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),2)) |> 
  kbl(col.names = c("Sex", "Mean bill length (mm)", "Mean bill depth (mm)"),
      align = "ccc") |> # Manually set column names for final table and center text within columns. 
  kable_classic() |> # add a theme
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) # don't make it so wide.
```
